listing.name: Gears of War 2 — Gears of War 2 — native PC port (unofficial) (santiquiroz)
listing.summary: Act1 playable; Android throttles heavily and internet co-op remains experimental. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Gears of War 2 Xbox 360 complete extracted game files, including the original executable. Retail title 4D53082D; default.xex plus GearGame.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Download Windows runtime ZIP and supply own retail default.xex/GearGame; unfinished Android APK is also offered.

warnings: Act1 playable; Android throttles heavily and internet co-op remains experimental.
